beacon-popover-title:
Heading at the top of the notifications popover that opens from the bell.
{{Identical|Notifications}}
beacon-popover-empty: Shown in the notifications popover when the user has no notifications.
beacon-notifications-badge:
Text of the notifications badge in the user links, shown next to the bell icon or instead of it in skins without icons.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of unread notifications
beacon-notification-reverted-undo:
Header of the notification sent when someone reverts the recipient's edit. Plain text, rendered when the notification is created.

Parameters:
* $1 - username of the user who undid the edit, also usable for GENDER
* $2 - title of the page
beacon-notification-reverted-rollback:
Header of the notification sent when someone rolls back the recipient's edit. Plain text, rendered when the notification is created.

Parameters:
* $1 - username of the user who rolled back the edit, also usable for GENDER
* $2 - title of the page
beacon-notification-edited-user-js:
Header of the notification sent when someone else edits one of the recipient's personal JavaScript pages (User:Name/*.js). Plain text, rendered when the notification is created.

Parameters:
* $1 - username of the user who made the edit, also usable for GENDER
* $2 - title of the JavaScript page
beacon-notification-link-view-changes: Label of a notification link to the diff of the change.
beacon-notification-link-page: Label of a notification link to the page the notification is about.
